title: Slate configuration
description: Optional declarative white-labeling for the Slate viewer. All fields are optional; the same shape may be embedded as the 'config' header of a v2 manifest.

projectName.description: Header logo text and document-title suffix. Defaults to the root README H1.

logo.description: Path or URL to a logo image. Falls back to a generated monogram.

brandColor.description: Hex color that drives the --color-brand-* token family.

defaultTheme.description: Initial theme before any user override. 'auto' follows prefers-color-scheme.

density.description: Sets the [data-density] attribute, scaling the spacing tokens.

landing.description: Content path opened at the root route and on logo click. Defaults to README.md.

contentRoot.description: Optional base path prepended to manifest, page, and asset fetches only. Hash routes remain the raw path. Defaults to empty (shell colocated with content).

themeStylesheet.description: Optional host-relative theme stylesheet also loaded by standalone Slate application surfaces such as Canvas.

readerPersonas.description: Optional reader perspectives used to prioritize authored sections without duplicating or hiding canonical content.

defaultReaderPersona.description: Configured reader-persona ID selected initially. Defaults to all readers.

parentDomain.description: The domain the documentation belongs to (for example 'example.github.io'). A link to it or any of its subdomains stays in the reader's tab; a link to anywhere else opens in a new tab and says so to screen readers. Defaults to the domain the docs are served from.

specReferences.description: Optional ID references. An inline code span such as `DEC-01` whose prefix is declared here becomes a preview button that quotes the matching table row or heading on the declared source page. Nothing is enabled by default.

prefix.description: Uppercase ID prefix. IDs take the form PREFIX-SEGMENT[-SEGMENT...].

route.description: Manifest path of the page that defines these IDs in a table's first column or in an h2-h4 heading.

label.description: Human label for the ID kind, shown in the preview source line. Defaults to the prefix.

summaryColumns.description: Zero-based table cells joined into the preview summary for row targets. Defaults to [1].

summaryField.description: For heading targets, the first-column label of the row in the following table whose last cell is the summary.

viewRoutePrefix.description: Optional route prefix of detail pages. A page under it that declares the ID in a table row labelled viewIdField previews its TL;DR and links there instead.

viewIdField.description: First-column label that declares an ID on a detail page under viewRoutePrefix.
